summary: Send an asynchronous renderer-to-main IPC message using structured-clone serialization.

target.notes: Validate and structured-clone arguments before enqueueing the asynchronous message.

caveats: Functions, Promises, Symbols, WeakMaps and WeakSets cannot be cloned and must throw.
DOM/special Electron objects that main cannot decode must throw.
Do not pass object references directly between translated components.

tests.name: send cloneable data
tests.expected_behavior: main receives a cloned data object asynchronously

tests.name: reject function argument
tests.expected_behavior: throws because functions are not structured-cloneable
